## Summary

<!-- What does this PR change, and why? Link the issue it closes, e.g. "Closes #123". -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change that fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change that adds capability)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that changes existing behavior)
- [ ] Docs / chore (no runtime code change)

## Verification gate

<!-- All of these must pass locally before requesting review. CI enforces them too. -->

- [ ] `npm run lint` passes
- [ ] `npx tsc --noEmit` passes
- [ ] `npm run build` passes
- [ ] No em-dash or en-dash added in `src/` or `prisma/` (plain hyphen only)

## House rules

- [ ] Colors use design tokens (no hardcoded hex/`zinc-*` in components)
- [ ] Interactive targets meet WCAG AA (min 44px touch, visible focus ring)
- [ ] Responsive grids include a `grid-cols-1` base
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or real student data committed
- [ ] AI features remain scaffolding, not ghost-writing (disclaimer preserved where applicable)
